TODAY

The app as it ships, rebuilt from the real Tailwind classes — #12151a on #fbfaf8, rounded-lg cards, shadow-sm, 14px body.

Here so the two directions get judged against the thing, not against memory. Flip the dark tweak on any artboard.

A · LEDGER

The bet: this is a worklist, not a dashboard. Card chrome comes off, hairline rules replace it, and Newsreader carries the figures. Going cold is promoted to the lead story with days-waited set in serif.

Why: nothing in the app is more useful than "who is about to go quiet", and it was a panel below six boxes.

Tradeoff: less obviously "an app". Fewer affordances are drawn, so a new member has less to click at.

B · CONSOLE

The bet: structure, not subtraction. Nav moves to a rail with live counts, Archivo replaces the system stack, teal joins amber, and status becomes a dot plus a word instead of a pastel pill.

Why: the top bar competes with every page heading, and seven destinations with counts beside them beats seven text links.

Tradeoff: 216px of permanent furniture, and the biggest departure from what's shipped.

BOTH KEEP: the ink-on-paper base, the token-inversion dark mode, tabular figures, and amber reserved strictly for "needs attention" — so neither is a rewrite of the palette, and both drop into the existing Tailwind tokens.

Controls are live. Filter pills filter, the scope and range toggles change the data, and every artboard has a dark tweak above it.
